name: The Bot Report corrections
policy: Every factual correction, newest first. The archive is never quietly rewritten.

corrections.note: The headline suggested Aaronson said AI labs had likely broken encryption in use today; in his Nov. 27 post he says the breakthrough he expects is in theoretical cryptanalysis and will not endanger currently deployed cryptosystems.
corrections.was: Has AI CRACKED internet encryption? Scott Aaronson 'virtually certain' AI labs are sitting on 'BOMBSHELLS'...
corrections.now: Scott Aaronson: AI labs will soon unveil a 'MAJOR BREAKTHROUGH' in cryptanalysis... but one he says won't endanger today's encryption

corrections.note: The headline attributed the therapy remark to more than one person present; the linked CNBC article cites one.
corrections.was: Jensen tells Nvidia staff 'I HURT ALL OF YOU'... says he's in therapy, people present say
corrections.now: Jensen tells Nvidia staff 'I HURT ALL OF YOU'... says he's in therapy, says one person in the room

corrections.note: The headline left out that the chips were reportedly diverted by other firms, according to people familiar with the inquiries.
corrections.was: NYT: Justice Dept. investigators gather evidence Nvidia chips were ILLEGALLY DIVERTED to China...
corrections.now: NYT: Justice Dept. has evidence OTHER FIRMS illegally diverted Nvidia chips to China, sources say...

corrections.note: The lead photo's credit linked to a different photo from the same event and gave the wrong licence.
corrections.was: Photo credit: Anders Eidesvik / CC BY-SA 4.0 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jensen_Huang_Stanford_2026-04-30_010_(cropped).jpg
corrections.now: Photo credit: Anders Eidesvik / CC BY 4.0 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jensen_huang_stanford_2026-04-30_005.jpg

corrections.note: The headline left out that the breached system was unclassified and that only some of the anonymous sources point to the AI tool.
corrections.was: CIA HACKED... SOURCES POINT TO A CHINESE AI TOOL
corrections.now: HACKERS HIT UNCLASSIFIED CIA SYSTEM... SOME SOURCES POINT TO A CHINESE AI TOOL
